data.description: ART_1 claims the log requires idempotence in the RFC 9110 sense because writers mutate state but retries must not compound. ART_3 claims the RFC 9110 distinction does not transfer cleanly to event-log writer semantics and the log requires a stronger, log-specific property (deterministic-replay idempotence) that is neither pure safety nor pure idempotence. The rivalry remains unresolved at formal sequence 281 (per PRC_11), with 10 accepted positions in contention.
